note: Company positioning (PRD §3, §12). Use this for the framing and the ERP-layer message.
whatHyperionDoes: Hyperion is an AI-native operations platform that helps operationally complex businesses run their daily execution — inventory, warehouse, manufacturing, central kitchen, delivery and fleet — in one place, with AI agents that automate the repetitive work.
operatingModes: A layer on top of an existing ERP (SAP, Oracle, Tally, Busy, Zoho, Ginesys, custom).
A control tower for operations visibility.
An AI agent layer that automates repetitive operational work.
erpPositioning: Hyperion does NOT replace the ERP. The ERP stores transactions; Hyperion automates the daily execution on top of it — reporting, approvals, exceptions, follow-ups and field operations — so teams stop living in Excel, WhatsApp and phone calls.
differentiators: Sits beside your ERP, not on top
